title: Vega in the Lyre above the zenith beyond the stargroup of the Tress of Berenice towards the zodiacal sign of Leo.
html_source:
From Wikipedia: “The traditional name Vega (earlier Wega) comes from a loose transliteration of the Arabic word wāqi' (Arabic: واقع) meaning "falling” or “landing”, via the phrase an-nasr al-wāqi' (Arabic: النّسر الْواقع), “the falling eagle”“. https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Vega
Stephen is associated with Icarus.
The Lyre (Lyra) is a stringed musical instrument; Stephen is an accomplished musician and talked about lute music in the previous chapter.
Leo is obviously a diminutive form of Bloom’s name, and there have been repeated associations between Bloom and cats (big and small).
This passage, therefore, might indicate a connection or transference between Stephen/Vega and Bloom/Leo.
